Project's HDFS UDF path

Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
-- =============================================================================
-- Author:              chengguo.liu@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-09-01
-- Theme Domain:        Activation AF Strategy
-- Data Granularity:    apply_no
-- Description:         Activation AF Strategy Summary Table
-- Documents:           
-- =============================================================================
--  Version History:
--  2025-09-01 - chengguo.liu - 初始化
-- =============================================================================

add jar hdfs://${IDC_NAMESPACE}/projects/credit/hdfs/udf/hive-udf.jar;
create or replace temporary function format_time as 'com.shopee.seamoney.udf.FromTimeStamp';

--drop table if exists risk_report.dws_risk_${region}_activation_af_strategy_df;
create external table if not exists risk_report.dws_risk_${region}_activation_af_strategy_df
(
    flow_trace_id string comment '流程追踪ID，用于关联申请流程',
    workflow_flow_no string comment 'AF工作流流水号',
    flow_no string comment 'AF策略流水号',
    shopeepay_user_id string comment 'ShopeePay用户ID',
    biz_id string comment '业务ID，格式: shopeepay_user_id_case_id',
    check_result string comment 'AF检查结果码: 1=自动通过, 2=自动拒绝, 32006=人工审核, 3=等待第三方数据',
    check_result_name string comment 'AF检查结果名称: Auto Approve/Auto Reject/Screening/Waiting For Third Data/Others',
    req_time string comment 'AF请求时间戳(毫秒)',
    handle_end_time string comment 'AF处理结束时间戳(毫秒)',
    req_date string comment 'AF请求时间(格式化后)',
    handle_end_date string comment 'AF处理结束时间(格式化后)',
    risk_scene_id string comment '风控场景ID: 80048=激活场景'
)
COMMENT 'Tag:risk report summary table'
partitioned by (grass_date string comment "YYYY-MM-DD 日期分区")
stored as orc tblproperties ("orc.compress"="zstd")
location '${HDFS_PATH}/dws/dws_risk_reg_activation_af_strategy_df/grass_region=${grass_region}'
;
--msck repair table risk_report.dws_risk_${region}_activation_af_strategy_df;

create or replace temporary view activation_credit_af_strategy_base as 
SELECT    
    get_json_object(extension, '$.flow_trace_id') AS flow_trace_id,
    workflow_flow_no,
    flow_no,
    shopeepay_user_id,
    CONCAT(shopeepay_user_id, '_', get_json_object(extension, '$.case_id')) AS biz_id,
    check_result,
    CASE
        WHEN check_result = 1     THEN 'Auto Approve'
        WHEN check_result = 2     THEN 'Auto Reject'
        WHEN check_result = 32006 THEN 'Screening'
        WHEN check_result = 3     THEN 'Waiting For Third Data'
        ELSE 'Others'
    END AS check_result_name,
    req_time,
    handle_end_time,
    format_time(req_time, '${grass_region}') as req_date,
    format_time(cast(handle_end_time/1000 as bigint), '${grass_region}') as handle_end_date,
    risk_scene_id
FROM      risk.dwd_risk_${shopeepay_af_region}_spp_gateway_req_rsp_final_result_di
WHERE     1 = ${has_shopeepay_af_region}
  and     grass_date >= date_sub('${current_grass_date}', 190)
  and     risk_scene_id = '80048'
  --and     get_json_object(extension, '$.flow_trace_id') <> ''
;

create or replace temporary view activation_credit_af_strategy as 
SELECT    
    flow_trace_id,
    workflow_flow_no,
    flow_no,
    shopeepay_user_id,
    biz_id,
    check_result,
    check_result_name,
    req_time,
    handle_end_time,
    req_date,
    handle_end_date,
    risk_scene_id,
    row_number() over (
        partition by flow_trace_id
        order by handle_end_time desc
    ) as rank_id
FROM activation_credit_af_strategy_base
;

insert overwrite risk_report.dws_risk_${region}_activation_af_strategy_df PARTITION (grass_date = '${grass_date}')
select
    t1.flow_trace_id,
    t1.workflow_flow_no,
    t1.flow_no,
    t1.shopeepay_user_id,
    t1.biz_id,
    t1.check_result,
    t1.check_result_name,
    t1.req_time,
    t1.handle_end_time,
    t1.req_date,
    t1.handle_end_date,
    t1.risk_scene_id
from
(
    select
        flow_trace_id,
        workflow_flow_no,
        flow_no,
        shopeepay_user_id,
        biz_id,
        check_result,
        check_result_name,
        req_time,
        handle_end_time,
        req_date,
        handle_end_date,
        risk_scene_id
    from activation_credit_af_strategy
    where rank_id = 1
) t1
;
